lu2026towards.title: Towards end-to-end automation of AI research
lu2026towards.supported_claim: The AI Scientist links idea generation, experiment coding and execution, analysis, manuscript writing, and automated review in an end-to-end research pipeline.

xu2026harness2.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
xu2026harness2.supported_claim: Harness^2 uses task-level contrastive Propose–Probe–Compose recursion and a harnessing-level recursion that extracts experience from edits for later tasks.

yang2026aris.title: ARIS: Autonomous Research via Adversarial Multi-Agent Collaboration
yang2026aris.supported_claim: ARIS combines execution skills and a persistent research wiki with integrity verification, result-to-claim mapping, claim auditing, and reviewer-approved harness improvements.

chandran2026production.title: AutoResearch at Production Scale: Failure Modes and a Multi-Agent Framework
chandran2026production.container: arXiv:2609.30541; accepted at IEEE ICDM 2026 Applied Track
chandran2026production.supported_claim: Production-scale AutoResearch reports infrastructure fragility, agent memory decay, search-direction stagnation, iteration-cost asymmetry, and metric fixation, addressed through prevent, persist, and redirect principles.

romera2023mathematical.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
romera2023mathematical.supported_claim: FunSearch pairs a pretrained LLM with a systematic evaluator in an evolutionary search over solution-generating programs.

agrawal2025gepa.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
agrawal2025gepa.supported_claim: GEPA reflects on execution traces in natural language to propose and test prompt updates and combines complementary candidates from a Pareto frontier.

huang2023mlagentbench.title: MLAgentBench: Evaluating Language Agents on Machine Learning Experimentation
huang2023mlagentbench.supported_claim: MLAgentBench evaluates language agents on 13 machine-learning experimentation tasks through actions including file editing, code execution, and output inspection.

novikov2025alphaevolve.title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
novikov2025alphaevolve.supported_claim: AlphaEvolve evolves code through an autonomous LLM pipeline with feedback from one or more evaluators.

liu2024evolution.title: Evolution of Heuristics: Towards Efficient Automatic Algorithm Design Using Large Language Model
liu2024evolution.supported_claim: EoH evolves natural-language heuristic ideas and their executable code within an evolutionary search framework.

jiang2025aide.title: AIDE: AI-Driven Exploration in the Space of Code
jiang2025aide.supported_claim: AIDE formulates machine-learning engineering as code optimization and uses tree search to reuse and refine promising solutions.

schmidgall2025agent.title: Agent Laboratory: Using LLM Agents as Research Assistants
schmidgall2025agent.supported_claim: Agent Laboratory organizes LLM agents across literature review, experimentation, and report writing, while allowing human feedback at each stage.

wijk2024rebench.title: RE-Bench: Evaluating frontier AI R&D capabilities of language model agents against human experts
wijk2024rebench.supported_claim: RE-Bench compares language-model agents and human experts in seven open-ended ML research-engineering environments under varying time budgets.

chan2024mlebench.title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
chan2024mlebench.supported_claim: MLE-bench evaluates agents on 75 Kaggle machine-learning engineering competitions and includes human leaderboard baselines.

yang2024sweagent.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
yang2024sweagent.supported_claim: SWE-agent studies how agent-computer interface design affects code editing, repository navigation, test execution, and agent performance.

chen2024scienceagentbench.title: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery
chen2024scienceagentbench.supported_claim: ScienceAgentBench evaluates 102 expert-validated data-driven discovery tasks using program quality, execution results, and cost.

jansen2024discoveryworld.title: DISCOVERYWORLD: A Virtual Environment for Developing and Evaluating Automated Scientific Discovery Agents
jansen2024discoveryworld.supported_claim: DiscoveryWorld provides 120 simulated tasks requiring hypotheses, experiment design and execution, analysis, and conclusions.

liu2023agentbench.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
liu2023agentbench.supported_claim: AgentBench evaluates LLM agents across eight interactive environments and analyzes reasoning, decision-making, and instruction-following failures.

liu2025cogalpha.title: Cognitive Alpha Mining via LLM-Driven Code-Based Evolution
liu2025cogalpha.supported_claim: CogAlpha represents alphas as code and combines LLM reasoning, evolutionary mutations and recombination, multi-stage prompts, and financial feedback.

yu2023generating.title: Generating Synergistic Formulaic Alpha Collections via Reinforcement Learning
yu2023generating.container: Proceedings of the 29th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
yu2023generating.supported_claim: AlphaGen uses reinforcement learning to optimize a synergistic collection of formulaic alphas through downstream combination-model performance.
